OnStar services and Wi-Fi hot spot capability keep you connected wherever your journey takes you.

The truck bed itself features a Chevytec spray-on black bedliner for durability, chrome recovery hooks for capability, and the intelligent Multi-Flex tailgate that adapts to your loading needs. The available power sunroof, distinctive 22-inch painted wheels with chrome inserts, and body-color bumpers and mirror caps give this truck a commanding presence both at the job site and around town.

- REBEL LEVEL 2 EQUIPMENT GROUP with premium features
- 14.4" Uconnect 5 Navigation touchscreen with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto

- Surround View Camera System with trailer reverse guidance
- MOPAR spray-in bedliner for maximum cargo protection

Inside the cabin, you'll find a workspace designed for professionals and work enthusiasts alike. The leather-trimmed power bucket seats with heating and ventilation provide comfort during long drives, while the full complement of premium controls—including the Uconnect 5 navigation system with a 14.4-inch display—keeps you connected and informed. The 17-speaker Harman/Kardon audio system delivers exceptional sound quality, and the integrated connectivity features including Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, and 4G LTE Wi-Fi hotspot ensure you remain productive wherever the road leads.

The Rebel's towing and hauling capabilities are reinforced by thoughtful engineering. The MOPAR spray-in bedliner protects your cargo box, while the LED bed lighting illuminates your work area after dark. The Surround View Camera System with trailer reverse guidance takes the guesswork out of towing operations, and the trailer tire pressure monitoring system keeps you aware of your trailer's vital signs. The power deployable running boards and MOPAR deployable bed step make accessing the truck bed intuitive and safe.

Black Diamond Cut aluminum 20-inch wheels give the Rebel a distinctive appearance while the Black exterior demands attention on the road. The truck's capable stance is matched by its practical features: power telescoping mirrors with heated elements and turn signal indicators, automatic headlights with fog lights, and a rear-view backup camera ensure visibility in all conditions. Climate control extends beyond the cabin with a block heater for winter reliability.

Technology seamlessly integrates into your daily routine with features like Alexa built-in, allowing voice control without distraction. The Media Hub, dual wireless charging pads, and multiple USB connections keep your devices powered and accessible. The 115V auxiliary rear power outlet expands your capability for job site tools and equipment. SiriusXM 360L satellite radio with over 360 channels means entertainment and information travel with you.

Every detail on this 2025 Ram 2500 Rebel reflects a commitment to capability, comfort, and connection. From the 4WD system to the premium interior appointments, this truck is ready to work as hard as you do. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience the Rebel's commanding presence and discover why this truck is the choice for those who refuse to settle.

The telescoping and tilt steering wheel allows you to find your ideal driving position, while the rear step bumper and exterior parking camera provide practical assistance during maneuvering.

Safety remains integrated throughout the design. Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control work continuously to maintain grip and stability. Dual front and side impact airbags along with an overhead airbag provide comprehensive occupant protection. Four-wheel disc brakes with brake assist offer confident stopping power whether hauling a full load or traveling empty.

The cabin accommodates both work and comfort. Dual front reading lights and rear reading lights ensure visibility throughout the interior. An overhead console and compass keep you oriented, while the trip computer provides detailed vehicle performance data. Passenger amenities include a vanity mirror and split folding rear seat for flexible interior configurations.

At 78,410 miles, this F-350SD has been maintained and continues to deliver the capability this class demands. The Limited Slip differential with 3.73 Axle Ratio balances hauling torque with operational efficiency. Whether you need a truck for professional work or substantial personal projects, this Lariat offers the combination of proven engineering and premium comfort.

The 2023 Ford F-150 Lightning takes America's familiar full-size pickup formula and gives it an entirely different kind of muscle, and this LARIAT SuperCrew, finished in Agate Black Metallic, backs that up with the highly desirable Extended-Range Battery and a genuinely comprehensive factory build. Off-lease with just under 39,700 miles, this Lightning is ready to keep proving that electric and capable aren't mutually exclusive. Dual electric motors give this Lightning standard FOUR-WHEEL DRIVE, delivering the kind of instant, effortless torque that a conventional gas-powered F-150 simply can't match. Owners appreciate the confidence this brings whether towing, hauling, or just merging onto the highway. Why Shoppers Buy This Model Shoppers cross-shopping the Chevrolet Silverado EV, Rivian R1T, and GMC Sierra EV consistently gravitate toward the Lightning because Ford didn't abandon the things that make an F-150 useful just because the gasoline engine disappeared. You still get a spacious SuperCrew cab, a proper pickup bed, and serious towing hardware, but now propulsion comes from two electric motors delivering enormous torque virtually instantaneously. Removing the engine also created one of the Lightning's signature features: the Mega Power Frunk. This lockable, weather-resistant front storage compartment adds genuinely useful cargo space in a spot that would normally just be an engine bay. Automotive Press and Industry Recognition The F-150 Lightning made an immediate impact when it arrived, earning the 2023 North American Truck of the Year award and widespread recognition for successfully combining electric propulsion with genuine pickup-truck usefulness. Reviewers have also highlighted the Mega Power Frunk, Pro Power Onboard, and sophisticated towing technology as features designed to make electrification useful in ways unique to a truck, not just a lifestyle statement shaped like one. Warranty With 39,683 miles on the odometer and an original in-service date of May 30, 2023, this Lightning is STILL COVERED by Ford's factory protection. Powertrain and Safety Restraint System Warranty -- Covers the electric drive units, related powertrain components, and safety restraint systems against defects in materials or workmanship. Expiration: 05/30/2028 or 60,000 miles, whichever comes first. Electric Vehicle Component Coverage -- Covers the high-voltage battery pack and other EV-specific components, with a minimum 70 percent battery capacity retention guaranteed over the warranty period. This coverage transfers automatically and follows the truck. Expiration: 05/30/2031 or 100,000 miles, whichever comes first. Corrosion Warranty -- Covers rust-through of body panels. Expiration: 05/30/2028, unlimited mileage. Extended service plans may be available to provide additional peace of mind and help protect your investment moving forward. The Z71 Off-Road Package distinguishes this truck with genuine terrain capability. Off-road tuned suspension, hill descent control, protective skid plates, and a heavy-duty air filter ready this truck for challenging conditions. Dual exhaust with polished outlets adds a refined presence, while 18-inch bright silver wheels wrapped in 265/65R18 all-terrain tires deliver traction and durability. Climate zones for driver and passenger allow individual temperature preferences, and the rear window defogger enhances visibility.

Technology reaches new heights with the 15-inch diagonal head-up display projecting essential information into your line of sight. The rear camera mirror gives you a clearer view behind you, while the surround vision system provides multiple perspective angles. Wireless phone projection integrates your smartphone seamlessly, and the wireless charging pad keeps your device powered throughout the day. OnStar and GMC Connected Services keep you connected and secure.

Advanced driver assistance features work to enhance safety and confidence. Automatic emergency braking, forward collision alert, and lane keep assist with lane departure warning provide additional awareness. Ultrasonic front and rear park assist help when maneuvering in tight spaces. The trailer side blind zone alert and rear cross traffic braking are particularly valuable for towing situations.

This Denali is equipped for serious work, with a multicolor trailering app, integrated trailer brake controller, and hitch guidance technology making towing intuitive and controlled. The spray-on bed liner protects your cargo surface, while the CarbonPro composite bed resists dents and damage. Chrome recovery hooks and a heavy-duty air filter demonstrate the truck's capability-focused engineering.

Power-adjustable trailering mirrors with heating and auto-dimming functionality enhance visibility in varying weather conditions. The integrated trailer brake controller simplifies towing operations.

This 2023 Silverado 3500HD LT is positioned to serve as a dependable work truck or capable daily driver. - Intelligent Adaptive Cruise Control with Stop & Go

The striking black exterior is complemented by the chrome single-tip exhaust and body-color bumpers, creating a truck that commands attention on any road. The Twin Panel Moonroof floods the cabin with natural light, while the heated steering wheel and dual-zone automatic climate control ensure your comfort year-round. The 360-degree camera system gives you complete visibility around the truck, especially valuable when backing up with a trailer or navigating tight spaces.

The 3.5L V6 EcoBoost engine paired with the 10-speed automatic transmission and 4WD delivers capable performance across a wide range of driving conditions. The integrated Trailer Tow Package includes the Integrated Trailer Brake Controller and Pro Trailer Backup Assist, making towing smoother and safer. The electronic locking differential provides the traction you need when the terrain gets challenging.

Technology features include SYNC 4 with Enhanced Voice Recognition and Connected Built-In Navigation for a seamless driving experience. Ford Co-Pilot360 Assist 2.0 provides advanced driver-assistance features, while Speed Sign Recognition and Evasive Steering Assist add layers of safety. The B&O Sound System elevates your audio experience with premium clarity and depth.

The Tough Bed Spray-In Bedliner protects your truck bed from the rigors of work and play, ensuring your investment stays protected. Whether you're hauling cargo or enjoying weekend adventures, this F-150 Lariat is ready to perform.

Visit our showroom to experience this truck firsthand and discover how it can fit your lifestyle.

Luxury pickup buyers usually want two things at the same time: real truck capability and a cabin that does not feel like a compromise.
This 2023 Ram 1500 Limited is built around that idea. Finished in Delmonico Red Pearlcoat with leather seating, equipped with the 5.7-liter HEMI V8 with eTorque, an eight-speed automatic and four-wheel drive, it combines traditional V8 character with the upscale environment expected of Ram's flagship trim. With only 13,997 miles, it also brings an unusually low-mileage profile to the equation.

The HEMI V8 is the centerpiece for buyers who prefer the response and sound of a naturally aspirated eight-cylinder engine. Ram's eTorque system adds mild-hybrid assistance to smooth certain transitions and support low-speed torque delivery, while the eight-speed automatic keeps shifts unobtrusive in normal driving. Four-wheel drive gives the truck additional flexibility for wet roads, loose surfaces, ramps and outdoor use. Whether the route is I-75 through Tampa or a weekend tow toward Brooksville, the powertrain feels appropriately substantial.

Limited trim turns the interior into a genuinely premium place to spend time. Leather seating, extensive soft-touch surfaces, upscale trim details and power-adjustable comfort features give the cabin a level of finish more often associated with luxury SUVs. The broad center console provides useful storage for work items and travel gear, while the rear seating area offers the kind of passenger room that makes this truck realistic for family use. Long drives are easier when the second row does not feel like an afterthought.

Ram's large central touchscreen and Uconnect interface place navigation, audio, smartphone integration and vehicle settings within easy reach. The system is designed around large on-screen targets and familiar menus, which helps when using it in a moving truck. Available connected functions, premium audio and multiple charging points make the cabin useful for both work and travel. Remote-start capability is another practical advantage during Florida summers, letting the climate system begin working before everyone climbs in.

The truck's suspension tuning is one of the reasons this generation of Ram 1500 earned such a strong reputation for ride quality. It feels composed over broken pavement and expansion joints without giving up the body control expected from a full-size pickup. The elevated driving position provides a clear view of surrounding traffic, while parking and camera technologies associated with the Limited trim help make the truck easier to place in crowded lots around Wesley Chapel or New Tampa.

Of course, the bed remains central to the vehicle's usefulness. It can handle home-improvement materials, recreational equipment, work supplies or the bulky items that make a pickup valuable in the first place. The HEMI powertrain and full-size chassis also make the Ram a credible towing platform when properly configured and operated within its rated limits. The important point is that the luxury cabin has not replaced the truck's practical side, it simply makes that capability easier to live with every day.

This Ram qualifies as Ford Blue Certified under the established automatic rules. Included Blue Certified benefits are the 139-point inspection, 90-day/4,000-mile Comprehensive Limited Warranty, 24/7 Roadside Assistance and applicable FordPass Rewards Points. Blue is the correct classification because this is a qualifying 2017-or-newer non-Ford vehicle with fewer than 150,000 miles.

For a buyer who wants a pickup that can handle work, towing, family transportation and long-distance travel without feeling utilitarian, this low-mileage Ram Limited checks an unusual number of boxes. The Delmonico Red finish gives it presence, the HEMI provides familiar V8 performance and the Limited cabin makes daily driving around Tampa Bay feel far more refined than the average full-size truck.

- Tow Package with Advanced Trailering System and Integrated Trailer Brake Controller
- Safety Package II including Automatic Emergency Braking, Forward Collision Alert, and Lane Departure Warning
- Power-Retractable Assist Steps with LED lighting
- Power Sunroof on crew cab
- BOSE Premium 7-Speaker Sound System
- Navigation System with Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium

- Heated and auto-dimming power trailering mirrors

The cabin delivers genuine High Country luxury with perforated leather-appointed seating, automatic climate control with front dual zones, and a thoughtfully appointed driver environment. Every control feels substantial, and premium materials throughout reinforce the quality you expect at this level. The 10-way power-adjustable driver and passenger seats with lumbar support ensure comfort during extended driving, while heated and ventilated front seating adapts to any season.

Technology integration focuses on practical capability rather than distraction. The integrated trailer brake controller and Advanced Trailering System work in concert with the Duramax diesel engine to handle serious loads with confidence. Safety features are comprehensive and active rather than passive. Automatic Emergency Braking, Forward Collision Alert, Lane Departure Warning, and the Safety Alert Seat work together to keep you aware and protected. The Following Distance Indicator provides real-time feedback during highway driving, while IntelliBeam automatically manages high beam operation for optimal visibility without blinding oncoming traffic.

This Silverado 2500HD wears a distinguished beige exterior accented with chrome details, LED fog lamps, and a polished exhaust tip. The crew cab configuration offers genuine versatility with a full rear seat and power sliding rear window. Inside, all-weather floor liners protect the carpeted interior, while a power rear window defroster and engine block heater prepare you for demanding conditions.

At 40,042 miles, this truck remains essentially new with careful ownership evident throughout. The 10-speed automatic transmission paired with the proven Duramax diesel engine delivers both efficiency and durability that will serve you reliably for years ahead. - 3.5L PowerBoost Full-Hybrid V6 with 10-Speed Automatic and 4WD
- FORD CO-PILOT360 ACTIVE 2.0 with forward sensing system, BlueCruise, and Active Park Assist 2.0
- Twin Panel Moonroof
- PRO POWER ONBOARD - 7.2KW
- B&O Sound System by Bang & Olufsen with HD radio and 8 speakers including subwoofer

- LED Projector Headlamps with Dynamic Bending

- Wireless Charging Pad
- Integrated Trailer Brake Controller with Pro Trailer Backup Assist

The 3.5L PowerBoost Full-Hybrid V6 engine delivers substantial capability while achieving 23 mpg in both city and highway driving. The 10-speed automatic transmission paired with 4WD ensures smooth power delivery across all terrain types. Inside, the Lariat trim elevates the experience with leather-trimmed heated and ventilated front seats, a power adjustable steering column with memory, and dual-zone automatic temperature control. The B&O Sound System transforms your daily commute with premium audio quality.

Safety and convenience technologies distinguish this F-150. FORD CO-PILOT360 ACTIVE 2.0 features forward sensing to help prevent collisions, while BlueCruise and Active Park Assist 2.0 reduce driver fatigue during highway drives and tight parking situations. The 360-degree camera system with trailer reverse guidance makes backing up and parking straightforward. Parking sensors and auto-dimming headlights add practical safety benefits for everyday use.

Work functionality meets luxury appointments in the bed and exterior design. The Bed Utility Package includes BoxLink system, LED box lighting, and a power tailgate with integrated work surface. PRO POWER ONBOARD provides 7.2KW of onboard power for jobsites or outdoor activities. Chrome accents throughout—including the grille, door handles, tow hooks, and running boards—create a distinctive presence while reinforcing the Lariat's premium positioning.

The truck's capability extends to towing and hauling. The integrated Trailer Brake Controller and Pro Trailer Backup Assist technology help manage towing responsibilities with confidence. The electronic locking 3.73 axle ratio balances torque delivery with efficiency. Whether moving cargo or enjoying the open road, this F-150 performs with refinement.

This 2022 F-150 Lariat represents a well-appointed truck that serves equally well on the job and on weekend adventures. The combination of hybrid efficiency, premium amenities, and comprehensive technology makes it an intelligent choice for buyers seeking a full-size truck that doesn't compromise on comfort or capability. We invite you to experience this truck in person and discover how its blend of features enhances both work and leisure driving.

The 2022 Chevrolet Silverado 2500HD LTZ is built to deliver long-term value for owners who expect reliability and robust capability from their crew cab pickup. Designed for demanding use, this truck leverages a reputation for durability and resale strength, making it a smart choice for those focused on minimizing cost of ownership over the years.

Pragmatic buyers who need a truck that can handle both work and daily life will appreciate the Silverado 2500HD LTZ. Its 4WD system, heavy-duty features, and crew cab layout make it a versatile option for those balancing jobsite demands with personal errands or family trips. In regions like Lakeland, FL, its all-weather readiness and comfort-oriented amenities provide dependable service through changing work and weather conditions.

The Duramax 6.6L V8 Turbodiesel engine paired with an automatic transmission provides a proven foundation for sustained performance and longevity. Owners benefit from a powertrain designed to handle tough tasks and off-road challenges, backed by a reputation for operational stability. Four-wheel drive ensures that traction and control are available when towing, hauling, or navigating difficult ground, all while supporting low long-term maintenance needs.

Safety is a critical contributor to ownership value, and this truck features a comprehensive suite of protective technologies. With ABS brakes, electronic stability control, multiple airbags, traction control, and brake assist, it’s engineered to help reduce the risk of costly accidents. Off-road suspension and advanced stability measures also protect your investment by ensuring composure and control in demanding conditions.

A wide range of equipment is included in the LTZ trim to support daily comfort and convenience. Features such as heated front seats, dual-zone automatic temperature control, memory seat, power sunroof, and the Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Plus system elevate everyday usability. The Z71 Off-Road Package, heavy-duty battery, power up/down tailgate, and remote keyless entry make the truck practical and efficient for both work and leisure.

Against other trucks like the Ford F-250 Super Duty Lariat and Ram 2500 Laramie, the Silverado 2500HD LTZ stands out for its established reliability and the breadth of its work-ready features. The Duramax diesel engine and included packages are engineered to reduce unexpected costs and help maintain strong resale value, keeping long-term ownership costs predictable and competitive.

What warranty coverage did this truck originally include? The Duramax diesel powertrain was covered by a 5-year/100,000-mile transferable warranty, with corrosion protection for 6 years or 100,000 miles and roadside assistance for 5 years or 60,000 miles. Is the Silverado 2500HD considered reliable? Yes, Chevrolet’s engineering and the Duramax diesel’s track record are recognized for robust durability. What features make it practical for daily use? The combination of off-road suspension, heated front seats, and convenient storage features make it suitable for both challenging workloads and comfortable commuting.

This 2022 Ford F-250SD Lariat represents a robust work truck designed for buyers who demand capability and reliability. With its powerful 7.3L V8 engine producing 385 horsepower and paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission, this truck delivers the performance needed for both demanding jobs and everyday driving. The 4WD configuration ensures traction in varied conditions, while the white exterior maintains a professional appearance that suits any setting.

- TREMOR Off-Road Package with electronic locking rear differential and front limited slip differential
- Pro Trailer Backup Assist with 360-degree camera system and ultimate trailer tow camera
- 7.3L V8 PFI engine with heavy-duty 240-amp alternator
- Electronic locking differential with 4.30 axle ratio
- Tough Bed Spray-In Bedliner with tailgate guard and bed tie-down hooks
- 10-inch touchscreen with SYNC 4 and connected navigation
- B&O Sound System by Bang & Olufsen with SiriusXM 360L
- LED box lighting and fully automatic headlights
- PowerScope trailer tow mirrors with integrated heating
- Front leather seating surfaces with power driver and passenger seats
- Lane Departure Warning System and electronic stability control
- 18-inch low-gloss black painted aluminum wheels with all-terrain tires
- Automatic temperature control with front dual-zone air conditioning
- Auto high-beam headlights with fog lights
- Panoramic sunroof with power operation

The TREMOR Off-Road Package distinguishes this truck with superior suspension geometry, including unique front springs that increase ride height and performance-tuned shock absorbers front and rear. The package incorporates rock crawl mode and trail control mode, enabling this F-250SD to navigate challenging terrain with confidence. Additional elements include transfer case and fuel tank skid plates, water fording vent tubes, and all-terrain LT285/75R18E tires mounted on 18-inch black wheels with textured matte running boards.

For those who tow, the Pro Trailer Backup Assist system combined with the ultimate trailer tow camera package transforms backing into trailers from guesswork into precision. The 360-degree camera system provides views from multiple angles, while the rear view camera and trailer reverse guidance technology display guidance lines on the driver-oriented display. The electronic locking rear differential with 4.30 axle ratio provides additional traction when hauling loads.

Inside, the cabin reflects the Lariat's upscale positioning with front leather seating surfaces, power adjustable seats for both driver and passenger, and a leather-wrapped steering wheel. The SYNC 4 infotainment system with connected navigation integration keeps you informed during commutes or job site travel. Climate control features dual-zone automatic temperature management with rear window defroster capability, while the B&O Sound System delivers premium audio through ten speakers and SiriusXM 360L satellite radio access.

Safety and convenience features abound throughout this truck. Dual front airbags, side-impact airbags, and overhead airbags work with electronic stability control, traction control, and brake assist to provide comprehensive protection. Lane Departure Warning helps maintain road position, while rear parking sensors and an exterior parking camera aid in maneuvering. The auto high-beam headlights adapt to road conditions, and delay-off functionality prevents sudden darkness after leaving the vehicle.

This 2022 Ford F-250SD Lariat combines genuine work-ready capability with thoughtful comfort appointments. Whether you require a dependable workhorse or a capable daily driver, this truck offers the performance, features, and build quality to meet your expectations. We invite you to experience this vehicle firsthand at our showroom.

• Trailer Brake Controller: Integrates additional trailer braking control to support confident towing performance.

• SYNC 3 Voice Activated Systems: Provides convenient access to compatible connectivity and infotainment features through an intuitive interface and voice commands.

• Pre-Collision Assist with Automatic Emergency Braking: Adds valuable driver-assistance technology designed to help detect and respond to potential frontal collisions.

This 2021 Ford F-250 Super Duty XL 4x4 Crew Cab is far more than just a truck, it is the embodiment of Ford's commitment to formidable capability, rugged engineering, and hardworking versatility. Proudly offered to you by Harrison Ford in Wellington,

This 2026 Ford F-150 XLT Sport in gray delivers capability and refinement for drivers who demand both performance and comfort. With its 5.0L V8 engine paired with 10-speed automatic transmission and 4WD, this truck handles demanding work and daily driving with confidence. The XLT Sport designation brings premium styling and purposeful engineering designed to stand out on the road and perform when it matters.

- XLT Black Appearance Package with 18" gloss black wheels, black grille, and black running boards
- 5.0L V8 engine with auto start-stop technology
- 10-Speed Automatic transmission with 4WD
- Equipment Group 302A Mid with Intelligent Access and Push Button Start

- BlueCruise with 1 year and 90-day plan included
- Tow/Haul Package with integrated trailer brake controller
- Pro Trailer Back Up Assist and Pro Trailer Hitch Assist
- Dual-zone electronic automatic temperature control
- Power-sliding rear window
- SYNC 4 with SiriusXM 360L (3-year plan)
- 400W Pro Power Onboard in cab and bed

The truck achieves 17 city and 22 highway mpg, balancing power with reasonable fuel efficiency. Its 7,100 lbs GVWR payload capacity with 3.73 electronic locking axle ratio provides substantial hauling and towing capability for truck owners. The gray exterior finish complements the sophisticated black appearance package, creating a modern, aggressive aesthetic.

Interior appointments reflect the mid-level equipment group with comfort-focused amenities. The wrapped steering wheel, automatic headlights with delay-off function, and illuminated entry create a refined driving experience. Remote start with remote tailgate release simplifies daily operation, while the auto-dimming rearview mirror and power glass heated sideview mirrors enhance visibility and convenience in various weather conditions.

Safety and driver assistance systems are comprehensive. Ford Co-Pilot360 Assist 2.0 includes automatic emergency braking for oncoming traffic, adaptive cruise control with stop and go functionality, and lane centering assistance. The 360-degree camera provides complete situational awareness, while front parking sensors support maneuvering in tight spaces. Standard airbags, electronic stability control, and traction control protect occupants during normal and emergency driving.

The Tow/Haul Package with integrated trailer brake controller and advanced trailer assistance features makes this F-150 ready for heavy loads. The 5G modem through Ford Connectivity Package keeps you connected and informed on the road. At 8,689 miles, this truck is essentially new, offering almost full factory warranty coverage and the confidence that comes with a properly maintained vehicle.

The 360-degree camera and front parking sensors make maneuvering in tight spaces straightforward, whether you're parking at home or at a job site.

The Pro Trailer Backup Assist takes the guesswork out of reversing with a trailer, automatically steering to your selected direction as you control the accelerator. This 2024 Ram 3500 Big Horn delivers the capability and comfort you need for serious work or weekend adventures, backed by Ram's proven reputation for durability and performance.

- Cummins 6.7L I-6 Turbodiesel engine with Active Noise Control System and Diesel Exhaust Brake
- 4WD with 3.73 axle ratio for enhanced traction and control
- Dual rear wheels for increased load capacity and stability
- Heavy-duty front axle (6000# with hub extension) rated for demanding tasks
- 8.4" Touchscreen Display with Uconnect 5 connectivity
- Apple CarPlay and Google Android Auto integration
- SiriusXM Satellite Radio with 6 speakers
- Chrome flat cab-length side steps for convenient entry
- Front fog lamps and fully automatic headlights
- ParkView rear back-up camera
- Power-adjustable heated mirrors with supplemental signals
- Rear wheelhouse liners for protection
- Premium cloth 40/20/40 bench seating with power-adjustable driver seat
- Remote keyless entry and Bluetooth handsfree phone system
- Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control

The diesel engine stands out as the centerpiece of this truck's engineering. Built to handle serious loads, it includes heavy-duty engine cooling, a current-generation engine controller, and a capless fuel fill system. The dual 730-amp maintenance-free batteries ensure reliable starting in all conditions, while selective catalytic reduction technology supports environmental compliance.

Inside, the cabin combines practicality with comfort. The premium cloth interior features front seat back map pockets, center seat cushion storage, and a rear 60/40 folding seat. Power steering, air conditioning, and a tilt wheel make every drive more manageable. The Uconnect system keeps you connected with GPS antenna input, 4G LTE Wi-Fi hot spot capability, and access to emergency communication through SiriusXM Guardian.

Exterior details reflect Big Horn's no-nonsense approach. Chrome bumpers, chrome flat cab-length side steps, and 17" steel wheels with quality LT235/80R17E tires present a clean, professional appearance. Rear wheelhouse liners and box and rear fender clearance lamps provide protective features that matter.

Safety features include dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, overhead airbags, and an occupant sensing system. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS give you confidence during stops, while brake assist and electronic stability control enhance overall control.

With 55,955 miles on the odometer, this Big Horn remains well within its prime, ready to serve you for many years to come. Visit us soon to experience this capable truck firsthand and discuss how it fits your needs.
